name: Tsenta
long_description:
Tsenta is an AI career agent that matches you with jobs, applies automatically, and gets you the best offers on the market.

We grew to ~$3M Annualized in three months. 

We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so that candidates would always have someone on their side.

Today, more than 90,000+ job seekers trust Tsenta to automate their job search.
one_liner: AI career agent that finds matching jobs & applies on your behalf

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: We're both international students who applied to 3,000+ jobs between us last year. After spending several hours a day retyping the same fields into Workday, we started building Tsenta for ourselves, all throughout our summer Internships, and launched out of our dorm at Rose-Hulman.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
The average student applies to 200-400 jobs per cycle and spends 15-30 minutes per application on menial data entry -  hundreds of hours wasted on broken forms instead of networking or preparing for interviews. 

Every existing tool is either cloud-based and a black-box, or a slow chrome extension - and both are priced unnafordably for students, which is why we built transparent, on-device automation that actually works - and can fill out forms end-to-end.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: To make hiring effortless for both job-seekers and recruiters alike.

launches.title: Tsenta: Your AI career agent that applies to jobs & lands you interviews
launches.tagline: Tsenta matches you with jobs, tailors your resume & applies on your behalf. We applied to 3,000 jobs by hand and built this so that you don't have to :)
launches.body:
Hey everyone, Pulkit and Agnay here!

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hdlmaCSxiIk>

**TLDR:**

Tsenta **matches** you with jobs, **rewrites** your **resume**, and **applies** for you. We built this because we applied to over 3,000 jobs as international students, and no other tool worked for us. 45,000+ people use it now, and over 70% of our paid users have landed interviews.

Sign up at: <https://tsenta.com/r/ycombinator> | 25 free applications on us, no card required :) + a 25% launch discount on any plan!

**Why We Built Tsenta:**

Because job hunting sucks, and existing platforms suck harder. They either don't submit applications end-to-end reliably, don't give you visibility into what's being filled, or cost more per month than most students can afford. Which is why we built Tsenta to be the best platform on the market for job seekers, both feature and price wise.

**What Tsenta does:**

1. Matches you with over two million jobs in our database, updated every couple of hours.
2. Rewrites your resume and cover letter in ATS friendly formats.
3. Actually submits job forms on your behalf, handling account creation, email verification, & filling in OTPs on over 30 ATSs.
4. Tracks all of your applications for you, so you never have to rely on a spreadsheet again.

Tsenta also runs on iOS, Android, iMessage, WhatsApp & as a chrome extension in addition to the web, so you can apply on the go, chat with Tsenta to manage and submit jobs, and use the Chrome extension to bring your own jobs as you browse other websites.

Some of the places people have gotten interviews through Tsenta: Cisco, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, Intel, NVIDIA, Scale AI, Northrop Grumman, Raytheon, SpaceX and Teamworks.

**Who we are:**

We first met at a friend’s dinner back in 2024 and have been close friends for over 2 years now.

**Pulkit:** Coding since the age of 13,Built a language app with 1M+ downloads at 17, shipped Bhasha Sangam for the Govt. of India (500k+ users), dealflow tooling at Dexter Capital. CS @ Rose-Hulman '28

**Agnay:** Coding since the age of 11, Open-sourced Android device trees used by 2,000+ ROM builders, systems engineering at VIAVI, CS + AI @ Rose-Hulman '26.

**Our asks**

1. If you are job hunting, or know someone that is, send them to [tsenta.com/r/ycombinator](https://tsenta.com/r/ycombinator). 25% off any plan, first 25 applications free.
2. We want this to be the best career agent out there and are super product-focused. Tell us what's broken or shoot us ideas at: [founders@tsenta.com](mailto:founders@tsenta.com).
3. Hiring? We're building the employer side next and would love to hear where your process today breaks. Same email as above :)
